superseded.origin: synthetic-era defaults; never reconciled with live launch behaviour

corrected.lingering_rationale: the observer's purpose completes at its cap; a bounded cap plus a recorded exit reason covers the dead-listener hazard without adding an untested code path. Rollback before observer expiry remains the complementary runbook control.

measurements_the_correction_is_derived_f.name: redirect_verify_to_connect_seconds
measurements_the_correction_is_derived_f.note: 14:28:12 scope verification to 14:29:27 connection at the local listener; the observer's clock starts before this interval, not after it

why_120s_was_insufficient: the observer must be listening before the redirect is installed, so 120s had to absorb the /etc/hosts install, the full scope verification, and the measured 75s redirect-verify-to-connect interval, leaving roughly 20-35s of margin
failure_mode_prevented: an expired observer yields a result that reads as 'D. OBSERVER NOT CONTACTED' - a claim about MCC - when the true cause is the observer having exited first, and leaves an installed redirect pointing at a dead listener
